name: M3_PPS370MI_AddHead
description: Create a batch purchase order header for purchase order batch entry. The header holds all header-level data for a purchase order that is being imported from an external system and is grouped under a message number. The message number acts as a container for the header and all related batch lines, addresses, charges, texts and accounting strings until the batch is processed into a standard purchase order in M3. This operation is typically called after a message number has been generated by the batch entry start operation.

inputParameters.name: MSGN
inputParameters.description: Message number identifying the purchase order batch entry that this header belongs to.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility responsible for the purchase order represented by this batch header.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse where goods for this purchase order are planned to be received or stored.

inputParameters.name: SUNO
inputParameters.description: Supplier number for which this batch purchase order header is created.

inputParameters.name: DWDT
inputParameters.description: Requested delivery date for the goods on the purchase order created from this batch header.

inputParameters.name: HREF
inputParameters.description: Supplier's purchase order header reference used to identify the batch order with the supplier instead of the internal PO number.

inputParameters.name: ORTY
inputParameters.description: Purchase order type controlling how the order created from this batch header is processed.

inputParameters.name: CMCO
inputParameters.description: Communication code defining how purchase order documents from this batch header will be sent to the supplier.

inputParameters.name: PUDT
inputParameters.description: Order date for the purchase order represented by this batch header.
